summary: A bulk classroom upload is idempotent only if it matches local lessons to live pages by normalized title and plans the whole change set before sending anything; and it must stay plan-only while Skool's classroom write endpoints are undiscovered.
reason: Skool has no public classroom write API and this CLI's spec carries none, so the upload half cannot be built honestly yet — only POST /courses is confirmed to exist, by an unauthenticated probe. The planning half is fully determinable, so push computes and shows the real create/update plan and fails closed on --apply with the capture recipe. The classroom page-list shape is read heuristically because, unlike the single-course page, no shipped code proves its field path; a regen must re-confirm it.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli covers title-match idempotence, orphan reporting, the frontmatter contract, the classroom-only scope guard, and the fail-closed --apply path.
